rv.q: Granted, the build-a-bird Princess is larger than her breed, making the goose's subtle twists, turns , and expressions more visible to 400-plus audience members. And while remaining necessarily expressionless herself, lead puppeteer Leah Hofmann deftly works the puppet's handles through subtle movements while uttering a variety of amusing honks.
See The Snow Goose at Goodspeed before it becomes the next big Broadway hit.
Despite some worthy performances and artful puppetry, “The Snow Goose” gets lost in the marshes.

cn.t: Critics are largely charmed by Goodspeed's world premiere, praising its fine acting, staging, and puppetry as uniquely poignant, though one reviewer finds it flies off course.

vr.q: this felt more like a play with a lot of music as opposed to a more traditional musical comedy musical theater piece
